title: The integral transition inherits the ordinary tensor shift through its canonical quotient-completion comparison, not through an arbitrary exact-functo
statement:
Fix a finite-field datum $D$ with characteristic $p$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, an algebraic closure $\Omega$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-numbers, def-weil-algebraic-closure], and any scheme $Y$. Let $E\subseteq L$ be finite coefficient subfields of $\Omega$ [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set], represented by the specified coefficient models and inclusion $\iota:E\to L$. Write $\mathcal C_E=D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_E)$ and $\mathcal C_L=D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_L)$ for the intrinsic derived-complete full subcategories [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], with their inherited integer shifts [lem-weil-integral-constructible-triangulated] and inclusions $I_E,I_L$. Let $F:\mathcal C_E\to\mathcal C_L$ be the restriction of completed integral scalar extension [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension, lem-weil-integral-scalar-extension-constructible], namely sfConstructibleIntegralScalarExtension with the parameters $D.p,\ell,\ell\ne D.p,E,L,\iota,Y$. Let $G:D(Y,\mathcal O_E)\to D(Y,\mathcal O_L)$ be ordinary derived extension of the completed coefficient rings, namely integralOrdinaryDerivedScalar, and put $H=G\circ I_E$. Give $H$ its specified ordinary derived integer-shift comparison $h_{n,K}:H(K[n])\xrightarrow{\sim}H(K)[n]$, obtained by composing the inherited inclusion comparison with the termwise-derived tensor comparison [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization, lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison]. Let
$$\chi:H\xrightarrow{\sim}I_L\circ F$$
be the fixed ordinary-to-completed natural isomorphism sfIntegralOrdinaryComparison [def-zl-normalized-integral-scalar-comparison], using the canonical identification of a restricted functor followed by its inclusion with the ambient functor. Write $\beta_{n,Z}:I_L(Z[n])\xrightarrow{\sim}I_L(Z)[n]$ for the inherited inclusion comparison. There is exactly one coherent integer-shift structure on $F$, that is, a family of natural isomorphisms
$$c_{n,K}:F(K[n])\xrightarrow{\sim}F(K)[n]\qquad(n\in\mathbf Z,\ K\in\mathcal C_E)$$
satisfying the zero and addition equations, such that
$$
 I_L(c_{n,K});\beta_{n,F(K)}
 =\chi_{K[n]}^{-1};h_{n,K};\chi_K[n]
 \quad\text{for every }n,K.
$$
Here $u;v$ denotes composition first $u$, then $v$. The equality is in $D(Y,\mathcal O_L)$ after the canonical inclusion identifications; equivalently it is the heterogeneous equality in the recorded Lean declaration. No structure map from $Y$ to a finite field is assumed.

theorem integralTransitionCommShift_existsUnique (E L : Index l Ω) (h : E ≤ L) :
    ∃! c : (sfConstructibleIntegralScalarExtension D.p l hl
        (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) (Coefficient.{u} l Ω L)
        (coefficientInclusion l Ω E L h) Y).CommShift ℤ,
      (fun [commInst : (sfConstructibleIntegralScalarExtension D.p l hl
          (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) (Coefficient.{u} l Ω L)
          (coefficientInclusion l Ω E L h) Y).CommShift ℤ] ↦
        ∀ (n : ℤ) (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) Y),
          HEq ((((sfConstructibleIntegralScalarExtension D.p l hl
            (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) (Coefficient.{u} l Ω L)
            (coefficientInclusion l Ω E L h) Y).commShiftIso n).hom.app K).hom ≫
              ((sfIntegralConstructible l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) Y).ι.commShiftIso n).hom.app
                ((sfConstructibleIntegralScalarExtension D.p l hl
                  (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) (Coefficient.{u} l Ω L)
                  (coefficientInclusion l Ω E L h) Y).obj K))
            ((sfIntegralOrdinaryComparison l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E)
                (Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) (coefficientInclusion l Ω E L h) Y).inv.app
                  ((shiftFunctor (sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l
                    (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) Y) n).obj K) ≫
              (Functor.commShiftIso
                ((sfIntegralConstructible l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) Y).ι ⋙
                  integralOrdinaryDerivedScalar l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E)
                    (Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) (coefficientInclusion l Ω E L h) Y) n).hom.app K ≫
              (shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l
                (Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) Y)) n).map
                  ((sfIntegralOrdinaryComparison l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E)
                    (Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) (coefficientInclusion l Ω E L h) Y).hom.app K)))
        (commInst := c) := by
  sorry
